name: harvard-sentences-tts-benchmark
description: A collection of Harvard sentences recorded for TTS and speech evaluation purposes. It provides standardized short sentences intended for assessing speech intelligibility, naturalness, and TTS system quality across speakers and systems. Commonly used as test material for objective and subjective TTS evaluations.
reputation: based on the classic Harvard sentences, widely used in speech and TTS research for intelligibility and quality tests; a well-known, long-standing evaluation corpus.
